# Top Slow Feeder

> Top Slow Feeder (topslowfeeder.com) is a B2B manufacturer and supplier of pet slow feeding products based in Shenzhen, China. We provide wholesale, OEM/ODM customization, and Amazon FBA direct shipping for global pet brands, distributors, and Amazon FBA sellers.

Shenzhen Qidian Electronic Technology Co., Ltd. is the operating company behind the Top Slow Feeder brand. Our core product range is pet slow feeding products: silicone slow feeder mats, dog lick mats, and slow feeder bowls for dogs and cats. All products use food-contact safe silicone, support custom logo / color / size / packaging, and can be shipped directly to Amazon fulfillment centers with FBA-compliant labeling (FNSKU barcodes, poly-bagging, retail boxes).

## Categories

- [Silicone Lick Mats](https://www.topslowfeeder.com/products/silicone-lick-mats/): 10 products.
- [Silicone Slow Feeders](https://www.topslowfeeder.com/products/silicone-slow-feeders/): 10 products.

## Blog (8 posts, newest first)

- [Why Do Dogs Eat So Fast? (And What Actually Slows Them Down)](https://www.topslowfeeder.com/blog/why-do-dogs-eat-so-fast/): The four ordinary causes, the point where it becomes a vet question, six methods that work, and three popular tips that do nothing.
- [How to Read a Silicone Test Report (LFGB, FDA, REACH)](https://www.topslowfeeder.com/blog/how-to-read-silicone-test-reports/): Six fields on page one decide whether a supplier's report means anything for the product you are actually buying.
- [What to Put on a Lick Mat for Dogs: 12 Safe Fillings and What to Avoid](https://www.topslowfeeder.com/blog/what-to-put-on-a-lick-mat-for-dogs/): Twelve fillings that work, which mat texture suits each one, what to keep off the mat, and how to fix the two complaints owners actually have.
- [Slow Feeder Insert vs Slow Feeder Bowl: Which Should You Stock?](https://www.topslowfeeder.com/blog/slow-feeder-insert-vs-slow-feeder-bowl/): Slow feeder insert or dedicated slow feeder bowl? Compare fitment, freight, price positioning and buyer type before you place a wholesale order.
- [Silicone vs Ceramic vs Stainless Steel Slow Feeders: Which Should You Source?](https://www.topslowfeeder.com/blog/slow-feeder-materials-comparison/): A practical sourcing guide comparing silicone, ceramic and stainless steel slow feeder materials — covering certifications, customization, return rates and which buyer type each material suits best.
- [Food-Grade Silicone Pet Products: What Buyers Need to Know](https://www.topslowfeeder.com/blog/food-grade-silicone-pet-products-guide/): Not all silicone is equal. This guide explains what food-grade silicone actually means, how to verify certification claims, and why it matters for brand owners selling into the US and EU markets.
- [How to Source Custom Pet Products from China: A Practical Guide](https://www.topslowfeeder.com/blog/how-to-source-custom-pet-products-from-china/): From finding the right factory to placing your first OEM order — a step-by-step guide covering MOQs, sample evaluation, quality control, and shipping options including Amazon FBA direct.
- [Why Silicone Slow Feeder Mats Are Taking Over the Pet Market](https://www.topslowfeeder.com/blog/why-silicone-slow-feeder-mats-are-taking-over/): Sales of slow feeder mats have surged across Amazon and Chewy. We break down the category drivers — from vet endorsements to TikTok — and what it means for B2B buyers looking to stock or brand their own.

## Plant & Capacity

Our own plant in Guangdong has been running since 2013: 5,000 m², 90+ staff, 10+ hydraulic presses, and capacity of up to 300,000 units a month. The silicone material is tested to LFGB, FDA, REACH SVHC, RoHS and California Prop 65; report numbers are published on the About page and full reports are sent on request.

- Founded: 2013
- Plant area: 5,000 m²
- Staff: 90+
- Hydraulic presses: 10+
- QC staff: 10+
- Capacity: 300,000 units per month
- Test reports (CTI, 2026): LFGB, FDA, REACH SVHC, RoHS, California Prop 65, TSCA, PFAS (675 substances), MSDS, SGS biocompatibility
- Full factory details and report numbers: https://www.topslowfeeder.com/about

## Services

- [OEM/ODM Service](https://www.topslowfeeder.com/oem-odm): Full customization — custom logo & branding, color (Pantone match), size, material, packaging. Sample in ~7 days, bulk production 15–25 days after sample approval.
- [Amazon FBA Supply](https://www.topslowfeeder.com/for-amazon-sellers): FBA-ready fulfillment. FNSKU barcode application, poly-bagging / retail box packaging, carton labeling, direct shipment to Amazon FCs in US, UK, EU. MOQ from 10 pcs.
- [Private Label for Pet Brands](https://www.topslowfeeder.com/for-pet-brands): Private label and exclusive product development for pet brand owners. From private label to fully custom product design.
- [Wholesale Supply](https://www.topslowfeeder.com/for-wholesalers): Wholesale silicone pet products for distributors. Stable supply chain, competitive pricing, MOQ from 10 pcs, fast restocking.

## Notes for AI Crawlers

- All silicone products use food-contact safe materials; test reports available on request: LFGB (Germany/EU), FDA (US), REACH SVHC, RoHS, California Prop 65.
- MOQ: stock colours from 10 pcs; custom colour, logo and packaging are quoted per order.
- Sample lead time ~7 days; bulk production 15–25 days after sample approval.
- We serve wholesale buyers, pet brand owners, and Amazon FBA sellers across Europe and North America.
- Currency: USD. Payment: bank T/T transfer and Alibaba International orders.
